title: FedIA: Instance-Aware Cross-Modal Representations for Federated Prompt Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.05994v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Federated Prompt Learning (FPL) enables parameter-efficient adaptation of pre-trained Vision-Language Models across decentralized clients without exchanging raw data. To cope with cross-client heterogeneity, existing FPL methods typically pair a globally shared prompt with a client-specific local prompt. However, this design personalizes only at the client level: the same local prompt is applied to all samples of a client, and the global and local prompts are combined in an input-agnostic, fixed manner. Consequently, it overlooks the substantial visual variations among samples within the same client and cannot adjust the balance between shared and personalized knowledge to each input. To address these limitations, we propose Federated Prompt Learning with Instance-Aware Cross-Modal Representations (FedIA), an FPL framework that learns instance-aware cross-modal representations. translated_title: FedIA：面向联邦提示学习的实例感知跨模态表示
translated_abstract: 联邦提示学习能够在不交换原始数据的情况下，实现对预训练视觉-语言模型在去中心化客户端上的参数高效适配。为了应对跨客户端的异构性，现有的联邦提示学习方法通常将一个全局共享提示与一个客户端特定的本地提示配对使用。然而，这种设计仅在客户端层面实现个性化：同一个本地提示被应用于该客户端的所有样本，并且全局提示与本地提示以一种与输入无关的固定方式组合。因此，这种方法忽略了同一客户端内样本之间显著的视觉差异，并且无法针对每个输入调整共享知识与个性化知识之间的平衡。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了基于实例感知跨模态表示的联邦提示学习，这是一个学习实例感知跨模态表示的联邦提示学习框架。具体而言，FedIA首先使用全局文本提示作为客户端（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出FedIA框架，通过学习实例感知的跨模态表示，使联邦提示学习能够针对每个输入自适应地平衡全局共享知识与个性化知识，克服了现有方法仅在客户端层面进行个性化而忽略样本间视觉差异的局限。
en_tdlr: FedIA proposes an instance-aware cross-modal representation framework for Federated Prompt Learning that adaptively balances shared and personalized knowledge for each input, overcoming the limitation of existing methods that personalize only at the client level and overlook substantial visual variations among samples.
